name: Herige
summary: Herige trades in building materials for professional and DIY customers primarily in France. It also manufactures ready-mix concrete, industrial precast concrete, and insulated concrete forms, as well as industrial joinery under the BtoC brand. The company was formerly known as VM Matériaux and changed its name to Herige in May 2015. Herige is based in L'Herbergement, France.
